title: Mechanism of VCP Inhibition by a Novel Covalent Inhibitor
content: Unfolding and segregating proteins from different cellular compartments is a fundamental process in the cell to maintain protein homeostasis and viability [1]. In many cases, this unfolding process is performed by the Valosin-Containing Protein (VCP), also known as p97 in mammals and Cdc48 in yeast.
